title: A keyword that shifts with each rune
question: Do the archived page keywords plus any of nine fixed position steps produce a supported reading on the ten named pages?
reader_question: Could a page keyword change its shift at every rune?
summary: The strongest source word score was 86; 10 of 199 complete shuffled searches scored at least as high. A full known-reading plant recovered exactly and ranked first.
finding: The pinned source branch tested 90 settings on LP2-04–13. Best score 86 came from LP2-11 at step −2. All 90 decoded-output digests and 199 full-search shuffled maxima are recorded. A 209-rune known-reading plant recovered exactly with the intended step and scored 380.
limitations: The source English-substring score is a rough screen, and 199 within-page shuffles are not a cipher model. This result covers only ten page-specific keywords, nine source steps, page-local rune clocks and the source score. No alternate keys, resets, layers, languages or complete decryptor are excluded.
next_steps: A proposed different keyword or step schedule needs a rule fixed before examining its output, complete known-reading recovery, and an untouched passage check.

scope.representation: Exact committed Wulfic rune streams for old pages21–30, rune-for-rune aligned to current LP2-04–13.
scope.procedure: Apply each source-assigned GP29 keyword with all nine called progressive steps; score with the source English-substring function. Check one full known-reading plant and 199 shared page shuffles of the entire 90-case grid.
scope.parameters: 10 pages × 9 source steps = 90 candidate outputs; 199 complete shared page-shuffle searches, seed 20261023.
scope.exclusions: Other branches of advanced_cipher_solver.py, pages without assigned keywords, other step values or scoring models.

review.kind: bounded source-function replay with a full-message power gate
review.reviewer: Exact pinned source functions, independent all-case arithmetic and source-score checker, source/site rune parity

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library plus exact public Wulfic Git checkout at bf89d3d13aad2b8f2c95ab195cf1b092f250775c; upstream unlicensed source read by verified Git blob and not bundled.

visuals.caption: The strongest source score compared with 199 whole-grid shuffled searches and the known-reading recovery gate.

reader_finding: The nine tested step sizes produced no established reading on LP2-04–13. The best word score was matched or beaten by 10 of 199 complete shuffled searches. The same search recovered a 209-rune known message when it used the tested key rule.
reader_limit: Only the ten assigned keywords and nine fixed step sizes were tested. Other keywords, changing step schedules, resets and languages remain open.
